description: A partial function on natural numbers is partial recursive exactly when its set of successful input-output pairs is computably enumerable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.partial_recursive_iff_graph_enumerable (f : ℕ → Part ℕ) :
  Nat.Partrec f ↔ REPred (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.Graph f)
